clips.title: The story
paras: Overlord Ramtusk is the grizzled commander of the Death's Head tribe's military forces deep within Razorfen Kraul. A massive, aging quilboar warrior, his hide is heavily scarred from decades of brutal clashes across the Barrens. Striking him down shatters the martial backbone of the Kraul's defenders.

Overlord Ramtusk has survived decades in one of Kalimdor's most violent frontiers. His thick, leathery hide is crisscrossed with deep scars earned in skirmishes against centaur raiding parties, feral harpies, encroaching orcs, and stalwart tauren braves. While advanced age slows many warriors, Ramtusk's seasoned instincts and physical resilience have only hardened, allowing him to rule Razorfen Kraul's standing garrison with unyielding authority.
